title: Neural Compression over Equivalence Classes: Exact Gauges and Functional Rate-Distortion
abstract: arXiv:2611.07233v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural networks admit many parameterizations of the same or nearly the same function, but deployment typically stores whichever parameter vector training happens to produce. We show that this representational freedom can itself be used for compression. Rather than redesigning the codec, we search over exact function-preserving transformations and controlled functional perturbations, using the unchanged physical compressor itself to select cheaper representations. Exact gauge families provide a zero-distortion reference under the strict audit; allowing small functional changes exposes much larger rate-distortion gains. Across SmolLM2 and Qwen3, our method reduces Zstandard-compressed checkpoint size by up to 23.4\%, with similar relative reductions under gzip, Brotli, and ZipNN, establishing trained-network representational freedom as a practical storage resource.

translated_title: 等价类上的神经压缩：精确规范与函数率失真
translated_abstract: 神经网络允许通过多种参数化来表示相同或几乎相同的函数，但部署时通常只存储训练恰好产生的那个参数向量。我们证明这种表示自由本身可以用于压缩。我们无需重新设计编解码器，而是在精确保持函数的变换和受控的函数扰动上进行搜索，利用保持不变的物理压缩器本身来选择更廉价的表示。精确规范族在严格审计下提供了零失真的基准；而允许微小的函数变化则能带来大得多的率失真收益。在SmolLM2和Qwen3上，我们的方法将经Zstandard压缩的检查点大小最多减少23.4%，在gzip、Brotli和ZipNN下也取得了类似的相对缩减，从而确立了训练后网络的表示自由度作为一种实用的存储资源。
tldr: 该论文提出在神经网络的等价参数化类上搜索精确的规范变换和受控函数扰动，利用现有压缩器本身选择更省存储的表示，在SmolLM2和Qwen3上最多可将压缩后检查点大小减少23.4%。
en_tdlr: This paper exploits neural networks' representational freedom by searching over exact function-preserving gauge transformations and controlled functional perturbations, letting the unchanged compressor itself select cheaper representations, reducing compressed checkpoint sizes by up to 23.4% on SmolLM2 and Qwen3.
